title: Census European e100 unowned candidates
changes: Record a bounded metadata-only census of potential unowned gameplay-region roots against the accepted e100 manifest.
validation: Scanned the authenticated EUR ROM and historical atlas interval for candidate Thumb PC-relative literal readers, excluding current source owners; all guarded inputs remained unchanged.
